description: Returns a book's vocabulary. view=summary (default) gives its size, distinct words, hapax legomena (words used once in the whole text), words found only in that book, and its most frequent and most characteristic words; view=hapax, unique or words lists those words (25 per page by default, limit 1-100, and nextOffset continues). Use when the user asks about one book's vocabulary, rare words or words unique to it.

limit.description: how many results to return (1-100, default 25)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

offset.description: how many results to skip; the previous answer's nextOffset is where its page ended

name: get_vocabulary
title: A book's vocabulary
